thread:
deploy-bot: Initiating blue->green mesh-fanout shift for router service.

deploy-bot: release router:v2.3.1 -> set canary 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then 100% if no regressions. Pins: session cookie pinning enabled. Change window: now until +1h.

kyle: ack. warming green pool (10 nodes). will start traffic ramp in 2m.

sona: quick check — session cookie name is ROUTER_SESSID? confirm sticky cookie TTL 1h.

maria: add perf watches: p95 latency > 500ms OR error-rate > 0.5% => abort.

ashley: LB health-check path is /hc/ready on port 8080, grace timeout 45s. I pushed config to infra repo: https://git.internal/r/infrastructure/route-configs/commit/abc123 :eyes: 

kyle: running weight change now. command:
```
curl -X POST https://traffic-orch.internal/api/v1/shifts \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"service":"router","from":"v2.3.0","to":"v2.3.1","stages":[{"pct":5,"dur":"10m"},{"pct":25,"dur":"15m"},{"pct":100,"dur":"30m"}]}'
```

deploy-bot: acknowledged. canary=5% applied.

maria: watching metrics dashboard (dash id: dash-router-23). alert hooks wired to #incidents and PagerDuty.

sona: cookie name confirmed. adding fallback: if cookie absent, route by header X-ROUTER-VERSION.

ashley: note for rollback: drain command below will remove new instances from LB, then revert weights.
```
# drain
curl -X POST https://traffic-orch.internal/api/v1/drain -d '{"service":"router","version":"v2.3.1","grace_sec":45}'
# revert
curl -X POST https://traffic-orch.internal/api/v1/shift -d '{"service":"router","to":"v2.3.0","pct":100}'
```

kyle: if p95 spikes > 500ms during 5% window, we're aborting and running drain above. I'll @maria and @sona on any abort.

maria: saw one 502 at t+3m, p95 still stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: escalating to 25% per schedule.

sona: pushing release notes and changelog: https://docs.internal/releases/router/2.3.1.md — includes KV cache fix and quantized kernel bump.

ashley: reminder: update RBAC for router metrics exporter (serviceaccount token rotated), PR merged.

kyle: 25% stable at t+20m. proceeding to 100% ramp in 5m.

maria: all clear. no error-rate or latency regressions. green to complete.

ops-bot: finalizing. pinned version router:v2.3.1 in config-store.

kyle: thanks everyone. oncall: me. will monitor 30m post-cutover.

maria: adding postmortem reminder: if any user-facing errors, file a quick follow-up in #postmortems.

deploy-bot: runbook note: rollback step requires manual confirmation from oncall. use /confirm-rollback.

kyle: got it. closing thread when 30m monitoring window completes. :white_check_mark:
